{{Quote|What of the enemy generator? Were you able to destroy it as planned?|Larbec|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Larbec''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] holding the rank of the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in [[3643 BBY]] he was stationed in [[Sobrik]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and asked a fellow Imperial to destroy a [[Balmorran resistance]] power generator.<ref name="TOR" />
